currentParagraphText: “No, I’m sure there are people waiting for you at your residence, and I have no desire to barge in on your reunion. Just contact me once you plan on heading to the Pantheon of Life. In the meantime, I plan on doing some shopping. I’ve run out of high-quality painting supplies,” the old man answered, subtly complaining once more about the lack of proper opponents on Earth as he’d evidently had time to do so much painting he’d run out of materials.
